title: Resume a coding job after process crash without duplicate dispatch
narrative: Fangore's host dispatches a long-running coding job through a durable plan. The MechaHarness process can die after the remote system accepts the job but before the plan records the result. On restart, the same durable store must reconcile the existing job instead of starting a second one. Crash points before intent, after intent, after accept, after reduce, and after final commit are all covered. Complements `fangore_insp_durable_resume` fingerprint refusal. Accepts the transactional durable resume requirements[^tdr-req]. Satisfies personal-agent MH-PA-05 checkpoint-compatible execution[^insp-pa-05]. Dots MH-DOTS-06 effect ledger is native here; auth-epoch resume is `fangore_insp_auth_epoch_resume`[^insp-dots-06-tdr]. Self-revising MH-SR-08 uses these checkpoints; neighbor-revisit conflict resolution remains `fangore_insp_decision_conflict_checkpoint`[^insp-sr-08-tdr].
implementation: `ArmedCrashProbe` + SQLite checkpoint durable resume for coding_job effects. `CliInstrumentor` verb `transactional_durable_resume`. Unit: `tests/fixtures/transactional_durable_resume/*.json`.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/crash_before_intent.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
